rationale: CORRECTED CONVENTION: shoulderFwdL/R + = BEHIND, - = FORWARD. Description: "Wrap arms around the knees OR hold a piece of fabric/wrap close to the body" — either way, arms must come FORWARD toward knees (not extend backward). Current shoulderFwdL/R=+12/+20 (behind) puts wrists at z=-0.167/-0.236 (behind body) and x=±0.55 (wide out) — opposite of wrap intent. Setting shoulderFwdL/R=-50 swings upper arms forward; combined with abducted shoulders (-40/-45) and deeply bent elbows (100°), forearms fold forward-inward to wrap around knees (knees at y=0.443, x=±0.04).
